rule: A member extension (fun Modifier.weight declared in RowScope) called on its receiver type inside a lambda whose receiver is the declaring scope, or in a class that declares or inherits it, is that scope's member extension, innermost first, never an invented Receiver#ext (C2); with the receiver's type undetermined, the enclosing class's member extension of that name applies when no scanned type declares a member of that name. An explicitly imported external extension (import ...psiUtil.leaves) called on a receiver is the imported function.
